name: reel
title: Reel
description: A filmmaker's portfolio where every project is a letterboxed title card — a black 2.39:1 picture holding only the serif title, client and year burnt into its corners like timecode, the description a yellow subtitle in the bar below — on a quiet grey-white ground.

tokens.--font-title: typeface of the title cards, the name in the header, page titles and the credited name — a transitional serif
tokens.--font-body: typeface of the story text on pages, projects and posts
tokens.--font-sub: typeface of the subtitles, the menu, labels, the footer and tables — a plain grotesque
tokens.--font-tc: typeface of the burnt-in corners, years and code
tokens.--text-s: size of the menu, labels, credits, the footer and table text
tokens.--text-l: size of the name in the header, the credited name, post titles in a list and third-level headings
tokens.--text-xl: size of the home statement and page titles on the light ground
tokens.--text-card: size of the title on a project frame in the grid, following the frame's width
tokens.--text-card-lg: size of the title on the full-width frame at the top of a project and the not-found page
tokens.--text-sub: size of the yellow subtitle in the lower bar, following the frame's width
tokens.--text-tc: size of the client and year in the frame's corners, following the frame's width
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of titles and headings
tokens.--color-bg: page background — the house lights up
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings and links on the light ground
tokens.--color-muted: labels, dates, secondary text and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: the bar under the current menu entry and the focus ring on the light ground
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines — credits, the list of more work, posts, tables, the footer — the bar beside a quotation and the bar under a hovered menu entry
tokens.--color-frame: the black bars of every frame, the corner windows, the little frame beside the name and selected text
tokens.--color-picture: the picture area between the bars when there is no cover
tokens.--color-card: the title lettering inside a frame
tokens.--color-tc: the client and year lettering in the corner windows
tokens.--color-subtitle: the subtitle in the lower bar, the inner focus ring on a frame, the dash in the little frame by the name and text selection
tokens.--color-scrim: darkening laid over a cover so the title still reads
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--reel-gap: gap between frames in the grid
tokens.--reel-min: narrowest a frame may get before the grid drops a column
tokens.--picture-ratio: shape of the picture between the bars, width divided by height — 2.39 for scope, 1.85 for flat
tokens.--bar: height of each black bar, as a share of the frame's width — 7.2cqi makes a 2.39 picture into a 16:9 screen
tokens.--space-1: spacing scale — tight: the gap under a label, rows in a list
tokens.--space-2: spacing scale — base: padding around menu entries and rows, the gap under the statement
tokens.--space-3: spacing scale — roomy: the gap between blocks
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — section: the gap above the story, above more work and above the footer
